independence_declaration.statement:
release-auditor authored no DG4 implementation, test, register row, ADR, repair, delivery decision, history rewrite or finding fix. That includes D-135, D-136, the D-136 SHA map and restored-paths list, findings.json, stages.json and environment.md limitation 6, all by the delivery-orchestrator. qa-verifier appears among the authors only for its pre-freeze acceptance tests (tests/qa, e2e), which the protocol allows.

I audited the frozen candidate directly:
- a complete disposable clone, $TMPDIR/c (not shallow, 1126 commits, fsck exit 0);
- a second clone, $TMPDIR/u, at f2ae717 for pnpm test.

Inputs: the three round-9 specialist records and their sidecars; every DG4 run's meta.json and sandbox.json, including the killed runs; findings.json, stages.json, decisions D-088 to D-136 and environment.md; and the content of the cited evidence. I read the round-9 specialist records only after forming my own checks of identity, rewrite, provenance and findings.

My only writes:
- evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG4/audit/round-9/;
- with the Write tool: this record, my findings and verifications sidecars, and the gate record.

checks_run.procedure: Verify the assignment hash. Make a complete git clone (not a worktree) under $TMPDIR and check that it is not shallow and passes fsck. Recompute the candidate in the clone at the source f2ae717 and at the freeze commit 01ad2e1, in the repository with --ref f2ae717, and on the repository working tree. Confirm that f2ae717 is an ancestor of HEAD, that f2ae717..HEAD changes only meta-excluded records, and that decisions.md and requirements.csv are untouched since the freeze (B1).
checks_run.command: sha256sum <assignment>; git clone --no-local /home/user/My-owns $TMPDIR/c; git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository; git fsck; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG4 [--ref f2ae717]; git diff --name-only f2ae717 HEAD; git log f2ae717..HEAD -- docs/delivery/decisions.md docs/delivery/requirements.csv
checks_run.environment: repository at HEAD 9d8906e; complete clone $TMPDIR/c; node v24.21.0
checks_run.expected: Assignment sha256 e5716501…f322. The clone is complete. All four computations give sha256:18c18fe4…d76c with 1475 files. Post-freeze changes are meta-excluded only, and decisions.md is unchanged.
checks_run.actual:
Assignment hash matches. The clone is not shallow (1126 commits), and fsck exits 0.

The candidate is sha256:18c18fe4eda7cbc1c9b2c42ffd22f5ec5c1c4851be1a34183cb118bd4ddad76c, 1475 files, in all four computations: clone at f2ae717, clone at 01ad2e1, repository --ref f2ae717, and the repository working tree. It matches the manifest 18c18fe4eda7cbc1.manifest.json (source f2ae717, frozen_at 2026-10-13T09:12:45Z).

f2ae717 is an ancestor of HEAD. The post-freeze changes are only the round-9 assignments, manifest, reviews, runs and test evidence, plus findings.json, progress.md and stages.json. There are 0 commits to decisions.md or requirements.csv since the freeze, so B1 holds.

Tabulate the same fields for every DG4 run directory, to judge D-082 for review runs in rounds 1-9.

checks_run.actual: domain PASS (13 checks), code-security PASS (22) and qa PASS (12). All are on sha256:18c18fe4…d76c, source f2ae717. Every check is PASS with exit 0, none is BLOCKED, and no new finding was raised.
